pullquote.text: Every contest gains something when the pursuer makes the pursuit credible.

stories.was:
The wider rivalry has fresh life after {winner} turns a season victory into recovered ground against the previously leading {loser}.

Sometimes the most revealing moment in a Showdown comes before the final result is known. {winner} has supplied such a moment by winning this season after beginning behind {loser} overall. The distance between their accumulated positions has contracted.

The lasting reward of a comeback is making the next season matter more.
